narrative: On the bookwheel. The Chaucer open on the desk at the Knight's Tale, a dent in the page from a cat's weight. Gib is on the floor, not on the book. The chronicle stands shut behind it. On the bookwheel. The same opening. A finger under the duke's name. No mark made. Theseus, duke of Athens. On the bookwheel. The chronicle's spine, upright, shut. The hand does not take it down. The Chaucer stays open on the duke riding home with the queen of the Amazons, to be wed.
